description: This Java source file defines an Android activity class 'PrintCustomContent' that demonstrates custom printing of a list of MotoGP statistics, including layout and rendering logic for print preview and actual print output. It includes implementation of a PrintDocumentAdapter with layout, writing, cancellation handling, and custom view measurement. The class also manages loading MotoGP data and rendering list items for print, with detailed print attributes handling.

classes.name: PrintCustomContent
classes.description: An Android ListActivity that demonstrates custom printing support for a list of MotoGP statistics, including layout, rendering, and PDF generation logic.
